title: Lift segment D: two-lane ramp climb, z101 to z110
description: Cart climb from the z101 floor at (88,105) to the z110 floor at (89,104). Lane 1 climbs south on x88 (ramps y106-111, z101-106), crosses a flat turn at y112 on z107, and lane 2 climbs north on x89 (ramps y111-109, z107-109) to an exit at (89,108,110). Dug from the top down: each channel removes a tile and leaves the ramp one level below it. Bedrooms at x86-90, y103-106, z107-109 sit 1 tile of rock west and north of the column.
hotkey: F12 'Jewelery' (106,96,110): the top end (89,104,110) is 17 tiles west and 8 south of it

phases.label: Access at z110: tunnel (89,105)-(89,107) and exit floor (89,108)
Lane 2 (x89): channels from z110 down to z108, leaving ramps z109-z107, plus the flat turn y112 on z107
Lane 1 (x88): channels z107 down to z102, leaving ramps z106-z101; the last one opens onto the z101 floor
Track: up lane 1, across the turn, up lane 2, out to (89,104,110)
phases.after: d1-d3 are dug (track cannot be marked on unrevealed tiles)

manual_steps: Run the phases in order, waiting for each to be dug: d1, then d2, then d3, then d4.
Short test: after d1 and d2, lane 2 alone is a 3-level climb. Push an empty cart up it by hand before digging lane 1.
Ramp rules here are from community posts, not the wiki; if lane 2 does not carry a cart, undo d3/d4 before they run.
Undo any phase with undo=true and the same phase id; dug rock cannot be put back, only designations are undone.
